department: GGNB, Cells and Organisms: From Genes to Evolution (Ph.D.)

deadline.value: GGNB has no application deadlines and projects can start throughout the year.
deadline.quote: We have no application deadlines and PhD projects in our center can start throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: You need a statement from the interested faculty member, and the application cannot be processed without it.
supervisor.quote: Important: without this statement, we will not be able to process your application

funding.value: University-wide, the research group or department usually funds doctoral students by contract or scholarship; this is not a guarantee for every applicant.
funding.quote: Usually, the research group or department provides funding to their doctoral students in the form of either an employment contract or a scholarship

entry_route.value: You need a Master's degree (or equivalent) in biosciences, chemistry, physics, medicine or a related field.
entry_route.quote: hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in biosciences, chemistry, physics, medicine, or related fields

english_waiver.value: English proof is waived if your Master's was taught in English; an English-medium Master's from India can meet this.
english_waiver.quote: completion of an M.Sc. degree in English or IELTS Band 7

notes: Programme is taught in English and run within GGNB. The Neurosciences MSc/PhD programme is saved separately as neuro.
